context_for_next_testing_agent: Lab Orders module fully functional. Key endpoints: GET /api/clinic/lab-studies (returns studies with id, name, category, preparation), GET/POST /api/clinic/lab-orders (CRUD with pagination), GET /api/clinic/lab-orders/:id (full order with patient, doctor, items), GET /api/clinic/lab-orders/:id/pdf-url (signed Supabase URL). PDF generated using reportlab and stored in Supabase Storage bucket 'patient-files' at path {clinic_id}/lab-orders/{order_id}.pdf. Frontend routes: /dashboard/laboratorio (list), /dashboard/laboratorio/nueva (new order form). Studies are displayed in 2-column grid grouped by category with checkboxes. Preparation instructions shown below study names. Priority options: 'routine' (default) and 'urgent' (red styling). Patient profile has 'Órdenes Lab' tab with 'Nueva orden' button.
